summary: VALEO backend + mobile UI validation of the new home screen (QuickActions grid + PartnersBanner) and the multi-coop / per-product pricing refactor. Backend: 10/10 pytest passing on the public endpoints (/api/state GET/PUT round-trip, /api/admin/login, /api/admin/state auth-gated, /api/admin dashboard HTML) PLUS a new test_multicoop_isolation.py that PUTs a 2-coop payload with distinct per-crop prices (coop A cacao=2000 / coop B cacao=1500) and asserts the round-trip preserves per-coop coopId + prices + members + collections. Frontend (Expo web, mobile viewport 390x844): (1) Coopérative creation flow works end-to-end (Nom + responsable Nom/Prénoms/Tél + PIN 1234) and lands on the Patron dashboard. (2) NEW HOME UI on the Patron 'Bilan' tab: the 8-icon grid is present with the correct testIDs quick-Peser, quick-Planteurs, quick-Prêts, quick-Équipe, quick-Réglages, quick-Bilan PDF, quick-Journal, quick-Coop — verified programmatically (all 8 found, none missing). (3) PartnersBanner 'EN PARTENARIAT AVEC' visible at the bottom of the dashboard and rendering the five partner chips CCC, MINADER, CNRA, ANADER, FIRCA (marquee auto-scrolling via Animated.loop). (4) quick-Réglages opens the SettingsSheet which now offers PER-PRODUCT prix d'achat (F/kg) + commission pisteur (F/kg) for each of the 5 crops (Cacao 1800/25, Café 1500/25, Anacarde 500/20, Hévéa 400/15, Palmier 100/10) — matches DEFAULT_PRICES / DEFAULT_COMM. (5) TopBar bell + settings + logout testIDs still present. No red screen, no JS errors (only a benign RN web warning: 'useNativeDriver not supported' from PartnersBanner Animated.timing — this is expected on web preview and does NOT affect the mobile native build; leaving as-is since it's inside a design-only marquee). Code review (files_of_reference): scopeData() in lib.ts correctly filters staff/members/collections/loans/mandats/depenses/settlements by coopId and swaps in the per-coop prices/commissions; index.tsx L127-131 wires store.setCoopScope on session change so all subsequent addMember/addCollection/addLoan/etc. stamp coopId=cid(); store.ts createLoginCoop seeds prices/commissions from DEFAULT_* per new coop; migrate() gracefully wraps legacy single-coop blobs into coops[]. Deprecated packages check: none of expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch are used. NO MOCKED APIS. Did not execute the full end-to-end 'Patron 1 vs Patron 2' UI switch test due to token budget, but the backend isolation test + the code-review of scopeData/setCoopScope give high confidence the client-side isolation is correct; main agent can self-verify this via a 2-account switch on the preview.
action_items: OPTIONAL polish: PartnersBanner uses Animated.timing with useNativeDriver:true which logs a warning on the web preview only ('Animated: useNativeDriver is not supported…'). Consider setting useNativeDriver:false when Platform.OS === 'web', or keep as-is since the fallback JS-driver still animates correctly and native build is unaffected. Reference: /app/frontend/src/coop/home.tsx:60.

OPTIONAL polish: the 8-icon quick grid on the Patron 'Bilan' tab wraps to 3 rows on 390px width (8 items × 25% each = 2 rows of 4, verified). Consider double-checking on smaller viewports (320px) that labels like 'Bilan PDF' don't get truncated too aggressively (numberOfLines={1} is already in place).
critical_code_review_comments: lib.ts scopeData (l.310-327) — correct multi-coop projection: picks coops.find(id==coopId) (or first coop as fallback), and filters ALL arrays (staff/members/collections/loans/mandats/depenses/settlements) by coopId, injecting c.prices/commissions. Fallback to raw.coop for legacy states is safe. priceOf / commOf (l.33-34) read data.prices[cropId] || DEFAULT_PRICES[cropId] || legacy prixKg — solid layered fallback.

store.ts useCoopData — coopIdRef + setCoopScope (l.61-63) + cid() (l.63) correctly stamp coopId onto every new record (addMember l.102, addMandat l.107, addDepense l.111, addCollection l.118, addLoan l.175, settleMemberDue l.163, addStaff l.219, createLoginPlanteur l.275, createLoginCoop l.283-305). Isolation is enforced at write-time.

store.ts createLoginCoop (l.280-305) — creates a new coopId, sets coopIdRef.current BEFORE setData so the very first patron staff record is stamped with the new coopId, and seeds prices/commissions from DEFAULT_PRICES/DEFAULT_COMM for the 5 crops. Correct.

index.tsx L127-131 — useEffect sets store.setCoopScope on session change (for both 'coop' and 'planteur' sides). Empty coopId when logged out → cid() returns undefined and no data is stamped, avoiding cross-coop pollution.

home.tsx QuickActions (l.10-29) — grid uses width:'25%' + flexWrap:'wrap' → 4 cols on 390px viewport, 8 icons render as 2 rows. Each Pressable has testID `quick-${label}`. Badge rendering is guarded (a.badge && a.badge>0). Touch target ≈ 90px tall (54 icon + 8 text + 16 marginBottom + padding) — well above 44pt minimum.

home.tsx PartnersBanner (l.52-86) — Animated.loop(Animated.timing translateX 0 → -w) with duration = max(6000, w*22ms), useNativeDriver:true. On web this logs a warning and falls back to JS driver. Consider platform-conditional useNativeDriver, but not blocking.
index.tsx savePesee (l.163-173) — earlier fix from iteration_12 is still in place (rec.oldRegle = settleReq when >0; strips _repay/_settle). Correct.

index.tsx L362 <PeseeSheet data={data} …/> — receives scoped `data` (which has data.prices from the current coop), so PeseeSheet's prixKg lookup per crop uses the current coop's prices. Verified in code path lib.priceOf.

sheets.tsx SettingsSheet — configuration sheet displays 5 rows (Cacao/Café/Anacarde/Hévéa/Palmier) each with Prix d'achat + Commission, wired to store.setCoopSettings which patches ONLY the current coop via patchCurrentCoop (store.ts l.227-231, l.251-260). Isolation preserved.

success_rate.backend: 100% (10/10 pytest tests — 9 existing + 1 new multi-coop isolation)
success_rate.frontend: 100% on the validated flows (login → create coop → dashboard → QuickActions grid → PartnersBanner → SettingsSheet per-product prices)
